newsitem.title: USA: U.S., resuming aid, gives Albania $12 million.
newsitem.headline: U.S., resuming aid, gives Albania $12 million.

text.p: The United States said on Tuesday it was reinstating its aid programmes for Albania, providing $12 million to prepare for elections set for June 29.
The word was formally passed to Prime Minister Bashkim Fino during a meeting on Monday with Secretary of State Madeleine Albright, spokesman Nicholas Burns said.
"So the United States government will now turn back on a lot of the aid programmes that have been suspended because of the (Albanian) political crisis," Burns told reporters.

The $12 million would go for election support carried out by the International Republican Institute and the National Democratic Institute and democracy-building assistance by the American Bar Association, he said.

It would also fund private sector economic development programmes by the Albanian-American Enterprise Fund; technical advice by the Urban Institute and agricultural assistance by a number of American non-governmental organisations, he said.

The aid programmes were suspended when pyramid financial schemes spiraled out of control three months ago, bankrupting thousands of Albanians and sparking a political crisis that took the country to the verge of anarchy.
Now the situation has calmed and the international community is trying to help the impoverished country hold new elections and re-establish order.

But Albania's political parties clashed over a new election law on Tuesday as Western security officials worked to prevent a fresh crisis and keep promised elections on track for the end of June. The elections are a key element of international efforts to prevent Albania sliding once more into the chaos and violence of February and March.
Under a six-point political contract brokered by OSCE envoy Franz Vranitzky last week, the election law should have been passed on Monday but the deadline had already been missed.

In their meeting on Monday, Albright told Fino "Albanian political leaders need to reach a consensus to hold the elections and to make sure that they agree on the steps necessary to prepare elections that can meet a standard of free and fair," Burns said.
Albright invited Fino to the United States to express her strong support for the forces of moderation and consensus in Albania as the country prepares for the June 29 polls.
